title: Department of State Kick Off Risk-Limiting Audit of 2026 General Election with Livestreamed Dice Roll
description: Department of State officials and staff kick off the statewide risk-limiting audit (RLA) of Pennsylvania’s 2026 general election. Department staff will roll 10-sided dice to generate a 20-digit “seed number,” which will be used to randomly determine which batches of ballots from the Nov. 3 general election will be audited over the next several days.
